title.zh: 计划文档新增交互层归纳（纯文档；上游结构归纳，不声明实现）
title.en: Add interaction layer summary to the implementation plan (docs only; upstream structure, no implementation claims)

intent.zh: 应用户 2026-11-12 要求（“接着完成交互层”），把冻结 MJWarp（71da24d）交互层的归纳写入 docs/implementation-plan.md：交互面分组与 M、A、R、G 节点对应、数据契约（Model/Option/Data 等字段与按世界取值）、交互流程、结论（批量、容量、标量选项与执行图、回调、录制）、对并行单元能力的依赖与留白。数字来自 U-AST 与文本静态扫描，未经运行验证；扫描脚本与结果是 target/physics-layer-scan/ 下的工作材料，不是验收证据。纯文档，写域仅 docs/implementation-plan.md 与本卡。
intent.en: Per the user's 2026-11-12 request, add a summary of frozen MJWarp's (71da24d) interaction layer to docs/implementation-plan.md: interaction groups mapped to M/A/R/G nodes, data contract (Model/Option/Data fields and per-world values), call flow, conclusions (batching, capacity, scalar options vs graph re-capture, callbacks, capture), dependence on parallel-unit capabilities, and caveats. Numbers come from U-AST and text static scans, not runtime-verified; scan scripts and output are working material under target/physics-layer-scan/, not acceptance evidence. Docs only; write scope is docs/implementation-plan.md and this card.

acceptance: docs/implementation-plan.md 含“交互层归纳”一节；UTF-8 / LF；位于“计算物理层归纳”之后、“数值验收方法”之前。
导出分组合计 99，与兼容矩阵“上游公开接口盘点”一致；不重列符号清单。
本节写明计数口径，区分 U-AST 与文本计数；推断项在留白中标明。
note: 用户直接要求；纯文档、零 GPU、零窗口。检查只用 gate fmt 与 forbid_claim，不用 unchanged src/，避免与运行中的 P1 代码片冲突。
